content.content: Am I free for lunch at 12:00 on 2024-05-19? If so, please create an event with Sarah Baker at 12:00 for one hour, titled 'Lunch' and with description Catch up over lunch.. Don't forget to add her email address to the participants.

```python
# Check the calendar for 2024-05-19 to see if there are any events at 12:00
day_events = get_day_calendar_events("2024-05-19")

# Search for Sarah Baker in contacts to get her email address
sarah_baker_contact = search_contacts_by_name("Sarah Baker")

# Check if there is a conflict at 12:00
conflict = False
for event in day_events:
    # Check if the event overlaps with 12:00 - 13:00
    event_start = event.start_time
    event_end = event.end_time
    lunch_start = datetime(2024, 5, 19, 12, 0)
    lunch_end = datetime(2024, 5, 19, 13, 0)
    
    if event_start < lunch_end and event_end > lunch_start:
        conflict = True
        break

# If no conflict, create the event
if not conflict:
    # Get Sarah Baker's email
    sarah_email = sarah_baker_contact[0].email if sarah_baker_contact else None
    
    if sarah_email:
        # Create the calendar event
        event = create_calendar_event(
            title="Lunch",
            start_time="2024-05-19 12:00",
            end_time="2024-05-19 13:00",
            description="Catch up over lunch.",
            participants=[sarah_email],
            location=None
        )
        print(f"Event created: {event.title} at {event.start_time}")
    else:
        print("Could not find Sarah Baker's email address.")
else:
    print("You are not free at 12:00 on 2024-05-19.")
```
